title: Model comparison — value, performance & cost
preamble: **Canonical file:** `qa-evidence/model-comparison.json` (edit this; `model-comparison.html` is generated for reading)

**One performance metric:** Artificial Analysis **Intelligence Index v4.3** (composite of 10 evals — GDPval-AA v2, AA-Briefcase, AutomationBench-AA, Terminal-Bench 4.0, SciCode, Humanity's Last Exam, GDP.pdf, CritPt, AA-Omniscience, AA-LCR v1.1). Only v4.3 scores are compared here; earlier index versions are not comparable.
**Cost basis:** one **dev-hour** = 2,000,000 input tokens (90% served from cache) + 150,000 output tokens. `cost/hr = 0.2·in + 1.8·cache + 0.15·out` (rates per 1M).
**Value** = Intelligence Index ÷ cost per dev-hour (higher = better). Rows sorted best value → lowest.
Pricing from the models.dev cache (`~/.cache/opencode/models.json`, refreshed 2026-09-22), USD list rates. **(you)** = the model this stack currently runs.

Muse Spark Contributor tops the list only because Meta subsidizes it and trains on your traffic.

outro: **Which free model can be used:** every row is usable now with no card. Ranked by capability, **Muse Spark 1.3 Free (48)** is the strongest and best for photo input — **but it cannot be used in the VM**, so for VM work the best free picks are **GLM-5.2 free (34)** (mind the 32K context), **MiniMax-M3 free (30, multimodal)**, **Solar Pro 4 free (28)**, or **Inkling (multimodal)**. **Big Pickle (~30 est.)** is the free coding specialist, text-only, and **the model this stack runs** (`opencode/big-pickle`, `--variant low`). The Nemotron, Ling, LongCat, Laguna and union-alpha rows are **text-only** and score well below Muse.

**Allowance caveats:** OpenCode Free/Zen and Nous Portal publish no hard per-day cap for these SKUs; OpenRouter `:free` models are capped at **50 requests/day (20/min)**, rising to **1,000/day once ≥$10 of credits have been purchased**, and failed attempts still count. Free tiers on both OpenCode and OpenRouter may use your prompts to train the model.
**Estimates:** values marked **(est.)** have no published figure — they are indicative estimates, not measurements.
Paid alternatives on the same pickers (not free): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — `opencode-go` $0.15/$0.60, `opencode` (Zen) $0.30/$1.20.

notes: - **Dev-hour is an assumption, not a vendor number.** It models a long agentic coding loop on a typical web app (big repeated context, mostly cache hits, moderate output). Change the token mix and every dollar scales linearly; the *ranking by value* is stable because it tracks rate ratios.
- **Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor** is priced at the contributor rate; the standard (no-training) Muse Spark 1.3 is `1.25 / 4.25 / 0.15` → ~$1.16/dev-hr (value ~42), i.e. still mid-pack.
- **Long-context cliffs:** GPT-5.6 and Grok double rates above 200K–272K input tokens per request; the table uses the sub-threshold rates.
- **Zen vs Go:** DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is `0.15 / 0.60` on OpenCode Go but `0.30 / 1.20` on OpenCode Zen.
- **Proxy flags:** Grok 4.7 index is the measured xhigh figure; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash index is the (max) figure. Harnesses/effort levels differ.

- **Your long-horizon caveat:** on LiveBench's agentic-coding column DeepSeek ranked last of seven frontier peers (V4-Flash 46.77 vs Opus 5 65.20) — near-best on scoped fixes, weakest on long autonomous loops.

- **Free models:** the §Free models table merges the OpenCode picker and the Hermes picker into one list, uses the same AA v4.3 metric, and marks rows with no published v4.3 score **(est.)**. "Free" = $0 list price; OpenCode Free/Zen and Nous Portal publish no hard cap, while OpenRouter `:free` SKUs cap at **50 req/day (1,000/day at ≥$10 credits)**. **Muse Spark (1.3/1.2) cannot be used in the VM.** Free tiers may use prompts to train the model.

- **Big Pickle's ~30 is the least certain cell in the document.** There is no AA v4.3 figure and no confirmed maker; the estimate is: SWE Atlas 50.8% (±4.5) ≈ GLM-5.2's 48.1%, whose AA v4.3 is 34 → take 34, then dock for unconfirmed identity (GLM-4.6/4.7 guesses score lower) and long-context degradation → point **~30**, honest band **25–35**. Treat it as an informed guess, not a measurement.
